name: Veldtmann ArcShield Insulated Work Glove
description:
Thick mid-forearm gloves in matte gunmetal dielectric shell over a compressed aerogel thermal core, stitched with high-visibility orange thread along the knuckle ridges and cuff. The back of the hand carries an embossed Veldtmann voltage-rating badge: 40kV Class E. Palms are anti-vibration gel-padded. Fingers are pre-curved for tool grip.

Widely issued on electrical infrastructure crews and MagRail maintenance teams across Tier 2-3. Durable enough to last three years of daily use; most pairs show tool-score marks and carbon smudging by month two.
functionality: Rated 40kV electrical insulation, Class E arc flash resistance. Anti-vibration gel reduces tool fatigue on sustained power tool operation. Thermal core protects to -30°C ambient. Not aug-compatible by design — insulation integrity requires sealed construction; chrome-hand workers use a separate aug-rated variant (not in current stock).
what_it_says: You work on systems that kill the careless, and you are not careless.
story_hooks: A pair is recovered near a sabotaged MagRail relay — the voltage rating badge has been scraped off, suggesting someone wanted the gloves untraceable.
Counterfeit Veldtmann ArcShields have been circulating on the Shelf; they look identical but fail at 8kV — workers have died wearing them.
A Tier 3 electrical inspector keeps a pair in their desk drawer despite working a desk job — they haven't explained why to anyone.
related_entities: Ringo Heavy Transit MagRail Levitation Transport Network

physical_description.visual_profile: Heavy-duty work gloves with a utilitarian aesthetic—mid-forearm length, structured hand shape, industrial presence. Matte gunmetal exterior reads as serious protective gear, the orange stitching providing high-visibility accent lines that catch light along knuckle articulation points.
physical_description.fit: Snug compression fit through the hand with reinforced knuckle zones; mid-forearm cuff sits secure but not restrictive. Pre-curved fingers optimize grip posture for repetitive tool manipulation. Designed for gloved-hand dexterity rather than bare-hand sensitivity.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte gunmetal dielectric composite shell (ballistic-grade polymer) over compressed aerogel thermal core; anti-vibration gel padding in palm zones.
physical_description.texture: Exterior: smooth, slightly textured matte finish with embossed badge detailing. Palm side: gel-padded, slightly tacky grip surface. Knuckle ridges: pronounced raised seams with high-visibility stitching creating tactile landmarks.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte gunmetal gray as dominant color; high-visibility safety orange thread running along knuckle ridges and cuff trim. Embossed voltage-rating badge in raised metallic gray on back of hand.
physical_description.closures: Friction-fit cuff with internal compression webbing; no external closures—designed for quick on/off during shift work.
distinctive_features: Embossed 40kV Class E voltage-rating badge on back of hand
High-visibility orange stitching along all knuckle articulation points
Aerogel thermal insulation visible as slight texture variation
Pre-curved fingers locked in tool-grip position
Anti-vibration gel-padded palms with grip texture
Veldtmann branding subtly integrated into badge design
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 issued equipment—corporate infrastructure sector. Represents mid-grade occupational gear with genuine safety certification, not luxury or sub-grade improvisation.
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals electrical maintenance worker, MagRail infrastructure crew, or corponation-affiliated technician. Wearing these in public marks you as either active workforce or recently employed. The 40kV rating communicates expertise in high-voltage environments.
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-broken-in after first month; tool-score marks and carbon smudging accumulate quickly from field use. Palms show darkened gel from repeated grip contact. Still functional after three years of daily wear, but exterior shows scuff patterns and minor tears in seam areas.
